comments.text: Petra is even more fascinating when you remember that it was never simply an abandoned archaeological site. 🏜🏛 Bedouin families actually lived among these tombs, caves and temples for generations, turning an ancient city into a living landscape. That human continuity adds a completely different layer to Petra, because history there didn’t end when the Nabataeans disappeared.
